title: Types And Process Of Succession
definition: Ecological succession is the directional, predictable, and sequential change in the species composition of a community over time, leading to a stable 'climax' community.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in Environment & Ecology (Prelims) to assess understanding of ecosystem dynamics, resilience, and biodiversity restoration.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Types And Process Of Succession.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
